author: GoPro
description:
Experience the power and beauty of Niagara Falls like never before in stunning 8K resolution. Captured on GoPro MISSION 1 PRO from @FPVEvan's drone, this cinematic aerial journey takes you through one of the world's most iconic natural wonders, revealing breathtaking perspectives of the falls and the swirling mist that makes this a bucket-list destination.

From sweeping aerial views to immersive low-altitude passes, every frame highlights the camera's ability to capture exceptional detail, dynamic range, and vibrant color in challenging conditions.
